in_sanskrit.name: Bhamini
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Powerful, Strong
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bhamini एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bha’ meaning ‘to shine’ and ‘Mini’ meaning ‘small’ or ‘little’. Bhamini represents a powerful and strong female presence.

in_hindi.name: Bhamini
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Powerful, Strong

in_tamil.name: Bhamini
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Powerful, Strong
in_tamil.long_meaning: Bhamini ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bha’ meaning ‘to shine’ and ‘Mini’ meaning ‘small’ or ‘little’. Bhamini represents a powerful and strong female presence.

in_telugu.name: Bhamini
in_telugu.long_meaning: Bhamini ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bha’ meaning ‘to shine’ and ‘Mini’ meaning ‘small’ or ‘little’. Bhamini represents a powerful and strong female presence.

in_marathi.name: Bhamini
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhamini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bha’ meaning ‘to shine’ and ‘Mini’ meaning ‘small’ or ‘little’. Bhamini represents a powerful and strong female presence.

in_bengali.name: Bhamini
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Powerful, Strong
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhamini একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bha’ meaning ‘to shine’ and ‘Mini’ meaning ‘small’ or ‘little’. Bhamini represents a powerful and strong female presence.
